answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. The mesa decay curve is applied at each close, jetty records the drop, and ember recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 8 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. Repeating the trick 40 times costs 33 separate deposits and 10 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
